using namespace std;

using ll = long long;
using pii = pair<int, int>;
using vi = vector<int>;
using vvi = vector<vi>;

mt19937_64 rng(chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count());

const ll INF = 1e18;
const int MAX_N = 1001;

int dx[4] = {0, 0, -1, 1};
int dy[4] = {-1, 1, 0, 0};

vector<int> adj[MAX_N];
bool visited[MAX_N];
int match[MAX_N];

bool in_bounds(int x, int y, const vector<string>& grid) {
    return x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < (int)grid.size() && y < (int)grid.size() && grid[x][y] != 'Y' && grid[x][y] != 'Z';
}

vvi bfs_search(int sx, int sy, const vector<string>& grid) {
    int n = grid.size();
    vvi dist(n, vi(n, INF));
    deque<pii> dq;
    dist[sx][sy] = 0;
    dq.emplace_back(sx, sy);

    while (!dq.empty()) {
        auto [x, y] = dq.front();
        dq.pop_front();
        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
            int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
            if (!in_bounds(nx, ny, grid) || dist[nx][ny] != INF) continue;
            dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
            dq.emplace_back(nx, ny);
        }
    }
    return dist;
}

void input_handling() {
    int N, T;
    cin >> N >> T;
    vector<string> g1(N), g2(N);
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) cin >> g1[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) cin >> g2[i];

    int rx = -1, ry = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
            if (g1[i][j] == 'Z') rx = i, ry = j;
        }
    }

    auto dist_from_reactor = bfs_search(rx, ry, g1);

    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
            if (!in_bounds(i, j, g1)) continue;
            auto dist_from_source = bfs_search(i, j, g1);

            for (int x = 0; x < N; ++x) {
                for (int y = 0; y < N; ++y) {
                    if (!in_bounds(x, y, g1) ||
                        dist_from_source[x][y] > T ||
                        dist_from_source[x][y] > dist_from_reactor[x][y])
                        continue;

                    if (dist_from_source[x][y] == dist_from_reactor[x][y]) {
                        bool can_escape = false;
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                            if (!in_bounds(nx, ny, g1) ||
                                dist_from_source[nx][ny] >= dist_from_reactor[nx][ny])
                                continue;
                            can_escape = true;
                        }
                        if (!can_escape) continue;
                    }

                    int c1 = g1[i][j] - '0';
                    int c2 = g2[x][y] - '0';
                    for (int u = 1; u <= c1; ++u) {
                        for (int v = 1; v <= c2; ++v) {
                            adj[100 * i + 10 * j + u].push_back(100 * x + 10 * y + v);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

bool augment(int u) {
    if (visited[u]) return false;
    visited[u] = true;
    for (int v : adj[u]) {
        if (!match[v] || augment(match[v])) {
            match[v] = u;
            return true;
        }

void compute_matching() {
    input_handling();

    int matching_size = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < max_nodes; ++i) {
        fill(visited, visited + max_nodes, false);
        if (augment(i)) ++matching_size;
    }
    cout << matching_size << '\n';
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    compute_matching();
    return 0;

vector<int> edge_list[MAX_VERTEX];
bool used[MAX_VERTEX];
int partner[MAX_VERTEX];

inline bool inside(int x, int y, const grid_t& g) {
    return (x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < (int)g.size() && y < (int)g.size() && g[x][y] != 'Y' && g[x][y] != 'Z');
}

vector<vector<llong>> dist_grid(int sx, int sy, const grid_t& g) {
    int n = g.size();
    vector<vector<llong>> dist(n, vector<llong>(n, LINF));
    deque<pii> q;
    dist[sx][sy] = 0;
    q.emplace_back(sx, sy);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        auto [x, y] = q.front(); q.pop_front();
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
            int nx = x + dX[k], ny = y + dY[k];
            if (!inside(nx, ny, g) || dist[nx][ny] != LINF) continue;
            dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
            q.emplace_back(nx, ny);
        }
    }
    return dist;
}

void read_data() {
    int n, t;
    cin >> n >> t;
    grid_t g1(n), g2(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) cin >> g1[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) cin >> g2[i];

    int rx = -1, ry = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (g1[i][j] == 'Z') rx = i, ry = j;
        }
    }

    auto d_reac = dist_grid(rx, ry, g1);

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (!inside(i, j, g1)) continue;
            auto d_src = dist_grid(i, j, g1);
            for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x) {
                for (int y = 0; y < n; ++y) {
                    if (!inside(x, y, g1)) continue;
                    if (d_src[x][y] > t || d_src[x][y] > d_reac[x][y]) continue;

                    bool special = (d_src[x][y] == d_reac[x][y]);
                    if (special) {
                        bool escape_possible = false;
                        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                            int nx = x + dX[k], ny = y + dY[k];
                            if (inside(nx, ny, g1) && d_src[nx][ny] < d_reac[nx][ny]) {
                                escape_possible = true;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if (!escape_possible) continue;
                    }

                    int cap1 = g1[i][j] - '0';
                    int cap2 = g2[x][y] - '0';

                            edge_list[src_id].push_back(dst_id);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

bool kuhn_match(int u) {
    if (used[u]) return false;
    used[u] = true;
    for (int v : edge_list[u]) {
        if (!partner[v] || kuhn_match(partner[v])) {
            partner[v] = u;
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

void run_solution() {
    read_data();

    int total = 0;
    for (int u = 0; u < MAX_VERTEX; ++u) {
        fill(used, used + MAX_VERTEX, false);
        if (kuhn_match(u)) ++total;
    }

    cout << total << endl;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    run_solution();
    return 0;
}
